title: Qualify versioned exact replay identities and optional bounded local semantic cache
commitMessage: feat: add versioned exact replay identity and local cache contracts

contribution.summary: Activate M2-W02-C03 and qualify deterministic domain-separated SHA-256 replay keys over ordered exact quantity steps, canonical rational magnitudes, unit definition and five explicit context versions; expose repeatable local exact replay and optional caller-owned bounded 32-entry FIFO cache; record independently observed missing-contract RED, 14 GREEN tests and locked composition/IR/foundation regression/package verification.
contribution.value: Consumers can identify reproducible exact arithmetic requests, invalidate identity on input or policy/version changes, replay without provider execution, and opt in to bounded in-memory reuse without confusing a cache hit with provider or AURA authorization.
debtChanges: M2-W02-C03-T2 remains planned; independently qualify partial status, cache quotas and replay portability boundaries before C03 or M2-W02 closure.
Caller-supplied provider/catalog/assumption labels are opaque identity metadata; they do not attest to installed providers, correctness or authorization.
Cache is optional, volatile, FIFO and bounded; no persistent store, remote cache, mutable global registry or provider execution.
No binary64 cross-platform bitwise reproducibility, AURA integration, permission, symbolic engine or external adoption is claimed.
contribution.nextAction: Qualify M2-W02-C03-T2 with adversarial cache-quota, partial-status and replay/version boundary tests; close C03 and M2-W02 only if all accepted evidence is satisfied.

achievements.achievement: A compiled independent RED verifies that no public versioned exact replay entrypoint existed before adding the new contract.

A domain-separated exact replay key includes typed numerical steps, unit semantics, assumptions/policy/catalog/tolerance/provider labels and supports optional caller-owned finite FIFO reuse without external execution.

Fourteen independent GREEN tests verify identity changes, deterministic exact replay, cancellation, cache hits/eviction, bounded inputs and no provider authority, alongside locked composition/IR/foundation and package regressions.
The bounded replay and semantic identity contract is qualified; cache integration and partial-status boundaries remain for T2, and C03 stays in progress.
